input.quote: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: The hosted-Services grant in Section 13.1 (Customer, Affiliates and contractors), the perpetual paid-up licence in Section 13.2, and the transfer/no-revocation protections in Section 13.3 all sit at or above the preferred position. The Deliverable licence in Section 14.2 is the outlier: it is expressly revocable, non-transferable, limited to Customer alone (no Affiliates or contractors), and expires with the Order Form term. That is walk-away territory (revocable at Vendor's discretion, affiliates and contractors excluded) and fails the fallback, which requires at least Affiliate coverage and successor transferability. The redline makes the smallest change to reach the preferred position by aligning Section 14.2 with the licence architecture already agreed in Sections 13.2 and 13.3; Vendor's underlying ownership of Deliverables is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual and irrevocable, extend it to Affiliates and contractors, and allow successor transfer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Deliverables are built and paid for specifically for us, so we cannot accept a licence Vendor can revoke at will that lapses with the Order Form term; our position is a perpetual, irrevocable licence covering our Affiliates and contractors and transferable to a successor. If Vendor prefers, we can instead align this sentence with the perpetual paid-up licence already granted in Section 13.2 and the no-revocation protection in Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for Customer's business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets, and revocable only as permitted by Section 13.3.
